name: Flex Tape Black Rubberized Waterproof Tape
description:
Seal, patch, and repair virtually anything with the super strong, rubberized Flex Tape. Designed for extreme durability, it works in all conditions—even underwater!

Key Features

Super Strong & Waterproof: Bonds, seals, and patches holes, cracks, gaps, and tears in almost any material.

Versatile Application: Works on wet or dry surfaces, hot or cold, and even underwater.

UV Resistant & Durable: Environmentally friendly and VOC-free, it withstands sun, moisture, and air exposure.

Instant Repair: Ideal for emergency fixes at home, in vehicles, boats, or outdoor projects.

Available Sizes: 10 x 120 cm (other sizes available for different needs).
